notes.title: Winter Update is Out Now!
notes.notes:
It's hard to believe that it's already been four months since Othello Let's go came out on Steam! We appreciate everyone who's playing the game. 

This Winter update includes:

 Winter graphics and UI
 Redesign the transition animations
 Fixed 'buttons not clickable in Lights-Out mode' issue

As a side note, the game will be released on Nintendo Switch by early 2021!

notes.title: New Update: 1.1.04
notes.notes:
We've got a new update!

This particular patch brings you:


 Separated background music and sound effect volume settings
 Fixed the win and lose sounds issue
 Changed the soundtrack list
 Marked with numbers and letters on the side of the board
 UI and typo fixes


- Studio Amateur

notes.title: New Update: 1.1.03
notes.notes:
Just a quick note: released a new update


 Improved the Championship (Level 7 & 8) AI, and reduced the response time on each move
 Added "Undo" button in Lights Out mode
 Verified and corrected the Minimum steps in Lights Out levels
 Fixed UI and text bugs


- Studio Amateur
